chunks: So which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the verse 'Fabi-ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this refrain is interpreted as a dual address to Jinn and Humans, highlighting the cognitive dissonance between recognizing divine favors and acting in gratitude. It underscores the concept of 'Tawhid al-Af'al' by reminding believers that all blessings originate from Allah, urging them to acknowledge His unity through thankfulness rather than denial.
